description: Show git diff with structured patch content. Returns parsed hunks per file instead of raw unified diff text. Use this when you need to see actual code changes, not just file-level stats. Use base+ref for two-ref comparison (e.g. base='main', ref='feature'). Use path to scope to one or more files or directories.

base.description: Base ref for two-ref comparison. When both ref and base are set, runs git diff <base> <ref>

context.description: Number of context lines around changes (passed as -U<n>)

path.description: Limit diff to one or more files or directories (string or array)

ref.description: Diff against this ref (e.g. 'HEAD~1', 'main', a commit hash)

name: git_diff_content
title: Git diff with content
